text: The regional council approved a new budget plan after several hours of debate late in the evening.
Officials said the public health campaign would expand to more rural districts before the end of the year.
The company reported higher quarterly earnings and promised to invest more in worker training programs.
Residents gathered near the main square to protest proposed cuts to local bus services.
A police spokesperson confirmed that an investigation into the fire was still ongoing.
The school board delayed a vote on the new attendance policy until next month.
Heavy rain caused delays on several major roads and prompted warnings for low-lying areas.
The hospital announced plans to open a temporary clinic for patients in surrounding neighborhoods.
Negotiators reached a tentative agreement on wage increases after a long overnight bargaining session.
